properties.description: Slice 1. A field on the member's dependency pin (external_dependency) carries the relation, and the interfaces for a uses link; upstream_status reads it back. The served /hub skill asks for the relation when a member is added and runs link-projects for each named interface. A health check reports a member whose relation is unset, or a uses link with no mirrored interface to follow. Additive: a pin without the field reads as 'relation not stated', never as a guess.
properties.name: A hub member records its relation (part_of or uses) and the interfaces it crosses on its pin; /hub asks for it when a member is added; a health check names a member linked by nothing
